items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I would say that (inaudible) influence on me, too, because I saw his name on so many films.

ctx.x: I guess This guy's got to do it, because they get so big, and so many movies, they can't do them all. God knows, Dmitri Tiomkin was quite capable of doing anything he wants to do.
